title: spec: the retired messageFormat key's guidance says interpolation is {variable}; the i18n service substitutes {{variable}}
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (an authored text states behaviour the runtime does not have) · Source: fleet (out-of-scope finding of the #37590/#37620 card thread, PR #37892; seat re-read on `main`)

## What happens

`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (about :3012), the tombstone guidance for the removed `messageFormat` key, tells an author: "interpolation is always simple `{variable}` substitution". The i18n service's file adapter (`packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts`, `interpolate`, about :81-89) substitutes `{{paramName}}` only, and leaves a single-brace placeholder as written. An author who follows the refusal's advice writes `{name}` and ships a message that prints `{name}` literally.

Read from source on `main`; not run. Other interpolating runtimes (console bundles) were not surveyed.

## Expected

- [ ] The guidance names the placeholder the runtime substitutes (`{{variable}}`), after a survey of every interpolating path, so the sentence is true of all of them.
- [ ] A pin that the guidance's spelling is the one the adapter substitutes.

Grade: area:ux · bug · reach: one refusal sentence an author acts on · evidence: source read above
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: XS
Related: PR #37892, #37620.
